content: Hi! This is Kelly from HR. How can I assist you with your payroll or account details today?
Hi Kelly, I just wanted to check if my direct deposit for June has been processed. I updated my bank info last month.

Thanks for checking in, Jordan. I see your updated account ending in 6732 at Wells Fargo under your name, Jordan L. Parker, was set up on May 24th. Let me pull up the June payroll status for employee ID JP-90845.
Perfect. I was expecting the deposit of $2,415 today, but it hasn't shown up yet. Is there a confirmation?

According to our records, the ACH transfer of $2,415 was initiated this morning with transaction reference HR-DEP-6621. The funds should appear in your account by 3:00 PM EST today. You should receive a digital receipt at your registered email, jordan.parker@westmancorp.com.
Thanks for confirming. Is there any reason it might be delayed? I have a rent payment due tonight.

There's no indication of any issues - your routing number (121000248) and account number ending 6732 matched perfectly. If you don't see the deposit by end of day, reply to the confirmation email or call our HR hotline at 1-800-555-1200 right away, and we'll escalate it before the 5:00 PM cutoff.
Understood. I'll keep an eye out for the confirmation email and let you know if anything is off. Thanks for moving quickly on this.
Of course, Jordan. Your digital receipt and the transaction details will be in your inbox shortly. Let us know if you need any more documentation for your records or if there's any further delay.
